camel_example: aliyun resourcemanager CreateControlPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyName ExampleControlPolicy --PolicyDocument 'Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole' --EffectScope RAM
description_en: Calls CreateControlPolicy to create a custom control policy
description_zh: 调用CreateControlPolicy创建自定义管控策略
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager create-control-policy --policy-name ExampleControlPolicy --effect-scope RAM --policy-document Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
Policy Name of the control policy.

Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, must start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1024 characters in length, must start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The effective scope of the control policy.

Valid values: RAM, which indicates that the control policy takes effect only for Resource Access Management (RAM) users or RAM roles
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略的生效范围。

取值：RAM，表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效
parameters.name: effect_scope

parameters.help_en:
The content of the control policy.

The maximum length is 4096 characters.

For information about the control policy language, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html.

For examples of control policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略内容。

最大长度为4096个字符。

管控策略语言，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html。

管控策略示例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.name: policy_document

AttachmentCount.description_zh: 管控策略被引用的次数

CreateDate.description_zh: 管控策略创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC
